plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Rio Hondo College GE pattern); the alternate Cal-GETC map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 61.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. MATH 150 carries a placement-based prerequisite in its official description (enrollment placement based on high school GPA/other measures, or completion of an intermediate algebra course) — not modeled as a course prereq. ACCT 101 lists only an Advisory (ACCT 100). CIT 155 lists only an Advisory (CIT 101). All other fixed courses on this map list only Advisories in their published descriptions; prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.
